items.t: Ukraine peace push stalls over alleged Putin residence attack
items.d: US envoy Jared Kushner blamed a claimed attack on Vladimir Putin's residence for setting back US-brokered Ukraine-Russia talks; Kyiv says it is waiting for Washington to set a date for the next round.

items.t: Hong Kong marks one year since deadly Wang Fuk Court fire
items.d: Residents and churches held memorials for the 168 people killed in the Tai Po blaze on 26 November 2025, the city's worst fire in decades, as authorities watched events closely.

items.t: UK confirms new EU deal can be cancelled, at a cost
items.d: Ministers confirmed the agreements signed in Brussels last week include an exit clause; quitting the food-and-plant checks deal within 10 years would mean paying to rebuild border checks. MPs debate the bill on 7 December.

items.t: Trump marks Thanksgiving with grievance-filled post
items.d: On the US holiday, President Trump used a late-night message to attack critics and a New York Times reporter alongside his Thanksgiving greetings.

items.t: Zelenskyy waits on US for next round of Russia talks
items.d: Ukraine's president said Kyiv is ready for more trilateral talks but the US has yet to fix a date, with territory and security guarantees still unresolved.

items.t: Kenyan court rules US-backed Ebola site unconstitutional
items.d: A senior court said the government broke the constitution by allowing a 50-bed US quarantine facility at a Laikipia military base without public consultation.

items.t: Iran arrests Oscar-nominated screenwriter Mehdi Mahmoudian
items.d: The rights activist was detained at his Tehran home on Wednesday with no official reason given, adding to a crackdown on cultural figures.

items.t: Wall Street banks set 2027 S&P 500 targets up to 8,700
items.d: JPMorgan sees the index at 8,200 by end-2027, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley at 8,700, even as AI stocks have slid about 32% since early October.

items.t: Volatility jumps as markets bet on a December Fed rate rise
items.d: Traders put the odds of a US rate hike next month above 90%; the VIX fear gauge rose 7% and the Nasdaq fell before the Thanksgiving market closure.

items.t: EU proposes €50bn fund to keep tech champions European
items.d: The Commission wants a Sovereign Tech Equity Fund backing AI, quantum, chips, cloud and cyber firms; it is still a proposal needing member-state support.

items.t: Pentagon talks to GM and Ford about building drone parts
items.d: US defence officials are in early talks with carmakers and supplier Magna about using car production lines to scale up military drone manufacturing.

items.t: FCC lets SpaceX launch up to a million AI data-centre satellites
items.d: Regulators approved SpaceX's 'Starmind' plan in phases through 2040, the first US approval of orbital AI data centres, raising questions about crowded orbits and astronomy.

items.t: OpenAI merges ChatGPT Chat and Work under one usage meter
items.d: Heavy users may hit limits sooner as OpenAI folds its chat and agent-style work tools into one allowance, reflecting rising computing costs.

items.t: Amodei calls claims Anthropic would cede control to AI 'absurd'
items.d: Anthropic's chief pushed back after rival AI executives criticised a view that some life-critical decisions could one day go to superintelligent systems.

items.t: X launches its first parental controls for teen accounts
items.d: Parents can set time limits, approve followers and limit DMs for 13-17-year-olds, but cannot read messages; both sides must agree to supervision.

items.t: Europe's biggest satellite factory opens in Belgium
items.d: Aerospacelab, renamed Ectro, opened a Charleroi plant able to build 500 satellites a year, including most of the EU's IRIS² secure-internet constellation.

items.t: New York Times reportedly bars latest Photoshop for photographers
items.d: The paper is said to have told photographers not to use Adobe's newest Photoshop, citing concerns over built-in generative AI editing tools.

items.t: China's Shenzhou-24 flies first foreign astronaut to Tiangong
items.d: The mission launched with two Chinese crew and Pakistan's first astronaut, the first international visitor to China's space station.

items.t: Hidden brine lakes found a mile beneath the Red Sea
items.d: Scientists mapped salty, oxygen-free pools on the deep seabed that preserve records of past climate and host unusual microbes.

items.t: Euclid space telescope spots its first unknown comet
items.d: The European mission, built to map dark matter, picked up a previously unseen comet in its survey images.

items.t: Astronomers float a possible primordial black hole, 'Phoebe'
items.d: An object about three times the Moon's mass may be a black hole from the early universe, which could help explain dark matter.

items.t: Net migration falls to about 77,000, lowest since 1997
items.d: ONS estimates show net migration down 62% in the year to June; PM Andy Burnham welcomed it and argued Brexit had weakened the border, while opponents demanded caps.

items.t: French strike cancels Eurostar trains between Paris and London
items.d: An unexpected walkout in France forced Eurostar to cancel services, leaving cross-Channel travellers stranded.

items.t: 烏俄和談受挫 美特使歸咎普京官邸遇襲
items.d: 美國特使庫什納指，有指普京官邸遇襲令美方斡旋的烏俄和談倒退；基輔表示正等待華府定出下一輪談判日期。

items.t: 宏福苑大火一周年 香港各界悼念
items.d: 大埔宏福苑去年11月26日大火奪去168人性命，是香港數十年來最嚴重火災；居民及教會舉行悼念活動，當局密切留意。

items.t: 英國確認與歐盟新協議設退出條款
items.d: 政府確認上周在布魯塞爾簽署的協議設有終止條款；若十年內退出動植物衞生檢疫協議，須承擔重建邊境檢查的費用。國會12月7日辯論相關法案。

items.t: 特朗普感恩節發文 大吐苦水
items.d: 美國感恩節期間，特朗普深夜發文，在祝賀之餘抨擊批評者及一名《紐約時報》記者。

items.t: 澤連斯基：等待美方定出下輪和談日期
items.d: 烏克蘭總統表示，基輔已準備好再舉行三方會談，但美國仍未定出日期，領土及安全保障問題仍未解決。

items.t: 肯尼亞法院裁美資伊波拉隔離設施違憲
items.d: 高等法院裁定，政府未經公眾諮詢便容許美國在萊基皮亞軍事基地設立50張床的隔離設施，違反憲法。

items.t: 伊朗拘捕奧斯卡提名編劇馬哈茂迪安
items.d: 這名人權活動人士周三在德黑蘭家中被捕，當局未有交代原因，被視為打壓文化界人士的又一例子。

items.t: 華爾街大行預測2027年標普500最高見8700點
items.d: 摩根大通預測標普500指數2027年底見8200點，高盛及摩根士丹利則看8700點；不過AI股自10月初以來已跌約32%。

items.t: 市場押注聯儲局12月加息 波動指數急升
items.d: 交易員認為美國下月加息機會逾九成；恐慌指數VIX升7%，納指在感恩節休市前下跌。

items.t: 歐盟擬設500億歐元基金扶植本土科技
items.d: 歐盟委員會建議成立主權科技股權基金，投資AI、量子、晶片、雲端及網絡安全企業，方案仍待成員國支持。

items.t: 五角大樓與通用福特洽談生產無人機零件
items.d: 美國國防部官員正與車廠及零件商Magna初步商討，利用汽車生產線擴大軍用無人機生產。

items.t: FCC批准SpaceX發射最多一百萬枚AI數據中心衞星
items.d: 監管機構分階段批准SpaceX的「Starmind」計劃至2040年，是美國首次批准太空AI數據中心，引起軌道擠迫及天文觀測的憂慮。

items.t: OpenAI合併ChatGPT聊天及工作功能 統一用量
items.d: OpenAI把聊天及代理式工作工具合併為單一用量額度，重度用戶或會更快觸及上限，反映運算成本上升。

items.t: Anthropic行政總裁斥「把控制權交給AI」指控荒謬
items.d: Amodei回應其他AI公司高層的批評；對方不滿Anthropic認為部分攸關性命的決定日後或可交由超級智能系統處理。

items.t: X首推青少年帳戶家長監控功能
items.d: 家長可為13至17歲子女設定使用時限、審批新追蹤者及限制私訊，但不能閱讀訊息；雙方須同意才可啟用。

items.t: 歐洲最大衞星廠房在比利時開幕
items.d: Aerospacelab易名Ectro，在沙勒羅瓦開設廠房，每年可生產500枚衞星，包括歐盟IRIS²安全通訊星座的大部分衞星。

items.t: 傳《紐約時報》禁攝影師用最新版Photoshop
items.d: 報道指該報要求攝影師不要使用Adobe最新版Photoshop，原因是擔心內置生成式AI修圖工具。

items.t: 神舟二十四號載首名外國太空人赴天宮
items.d: 任務載兩名中國太空人及巴基斯坦首名太空人升空，是中國空間站首位外國訪客。

items.t: 紅海海底一哩下發現隱藏鹵水湖
items.d: 科學家在深海海床發現高鹽、無氧的水池，保存了過去氣候的紀錄，並有罕見微生物棲息。

items.t: 歐幾里得太空望遠鏡首次發現未知彗星
items.d: 這個用來繪製暗物質分佈的歐洲任務，在巡天影像中發現一顆前所未見的彗星。

items.t: 天文學家發現疑似原初黑洞「Phoebe」
items.d: 一個質量約為月球三倍的天體可能是宇宙早期形成的黑洞，有助解釋暗物質之謎。

items.t: 淨移民降至約7.7萬 1997年以來最低
items.d: 統計署估計截至6月的一年淨移民按年跌62%；首相賓咸表示歡迎，並指脫歐削弱了邊境管理，反對派則要求設上限。

items.t: 法國罷工 巴黎往倫敦歐洲之星停駛
items.d: 法國突發罷工，歐洲之星被迫取消班次，大批跨海峽旅客受影響。
